description: This file defines the interface for a time management module, providing function prototypes for obtaining current time, calculating time offsets, comparing times, converting times to string and timespec formats, using the 'timespec' structure.

methods.name: rtTime_Now
methods.description: Gets the current system time and populates the provided rtTime_t structure.

methods.name: rtTime_Later
methods.description: Calculates a time offset that is 'ms' milliseconds after 'from' time (or current time if 'from' is NULL).

methods.name: rtTime_Elapsed
methods.description: Returns the number of milliseconds elapsed between start and end times.

methods.name: rtTime_Compare
methods.description: Compares two times, returning -1, 0, or 1 depending on their order.

methods.name: rtTime_ToString
methods.description: Converts a time value into a human-readable string format HH:MM:SS.mmm.

methods.name: rtTime_ToTimespec
methods.description: Converts an rtTime_t value into a struct timespec for use in system calls.
